title: Diwali 2026 phone sales in shops (AIMRA, reported 11-12 Nov 2026): offline smartphone unit sales down 18-20% YoY over Dhanteras (6 Nov) to 9 Nov; value roughly flat as average prices rose; week before Dhanteras down ~40%; most buying at ₹30,000-60,000; Realme offline volumes down 50%+; phones under ₹20,000 shipments down 47% in Jul-Sep (Counterpoint); makers preparing hikes of up to 15%; AIMRA expects offline volumes down as much as 50% over the next three months
